data.praxis.affondo_mentale.summary: Target a creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.aiuto.summary: Target yourself or a creature you can touch. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.amicizia.summary: Choose a creature you can see within range that is not hostile to you. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.attenuazione_inerziale.summa: You alter the inertial mass of your body to increase your mobility. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.boato_sonico.summary: You emit a powerful boom audible up to 30 meters away. (EC p. 18)
data.praxis.ciottoli_telecinetici.summar: You infuse up to three pebbles, bolts or other similarly sized objects you are in contact with with telekinetic energy. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.colpo_indirizzato.summary: You focus on a target you can see within range, gaining a precognition of its defensive tactics. (CRB p. 155)
data.praxis.disco_telecinetico.summary: You create a horizontal disc 1 meter in diameter and 1 centimeter thick, made of telekinetic force. (EC p. 18)
data.praxis.espediente_psionico.summary: You manifest a minor psionic trick, a sign of psychic power or an exercise that budding psionics use to practice. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.fascinazione_psionica.summar: Target a creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.fluttuazione.summary: You alter the tangibility of your body to avoid the full impact of an attack that hits you. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.illusione_minore.summary: You create the image of an object or a sound at a point within range that lasts for the duration. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.ipertermia_ipotermia.summary: You target a creature you can see within range and use your psychopower to alter its body temperature. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.lenitivo_biopsionico.summary: You place a hand in contact with a creature of your choice (including yourself), infusing its body with a psionic impulse that stimulates healing. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.luminescenza_corporea.summar: Your body radiates bright light in a 6-meter radius and dim light for an additional 6 meters. (CRB p. 156)
data.praxis.manipolare_materia.summary: You target a volume of visible space within range that fits within a cube 1 meter on a side. (EC p. 18)
data.praxis.mano_telecinetica.summary: You create a floating, invisible hand of telekinetic force that appears at a point of your choice within range. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.messaggio_telepatico.summary: You can send a telepathic message to a willing creature within range. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.ostacolare.summary: You hinder an enemy’s movements with the force of your mind. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.protezione_cinetica.summary: Target yourself or a creature you are in contact with. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.punto_cieco.summary: You erase your image from the mind of a creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.riposo_inviolato.summary: By touching a corpse you place it in a state of stasis that keeps it completely unaltered for the next 24 hours, as if time had stopped for it. (EC p. 19)
data.praxis.saetta_radiante.summary: You hurl a bolt of crackling energy at a creature within range. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.sovrapressione_sanguigna.sum: You target a creature you can see within range and use your psychopower to dangerously raise its blood pressure. (EC p. 19)
data.praxis.spasmo_metabolico.summary: Target a creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.spostamento_retroattivo.summ: You manifest this power as a reaction to an attack aimed at you. (EC p. 19)
data.praxis.stabilizzare_i_morenti.summa: You touch a creature at 0 vitality points. (CRB p. 157)
data.praxis.urto_telecinetico.summary: You create a wave of telekinetic force originating from you and spreading out to the range, covering a cone-shaped area in a direction of your choice. (CRB p. 157)
data.powers.afflizione_biopsionica.summa: Choose a Medium or smaller creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 160)
data.powers.afflizione_biopsionica.optio: The target has disadvantage on ability checks based on Perception, Intelligence and Technique. (CRB p. 160)
The target has disadvantage on ability checks based on Combat, Fortitude and Dexterity. (CRB p. 160)
data.powers.allucinazione.summary: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature you can see within range. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.allucinazione.increment.summ: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can target one additional creature. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.allucinazione.options.vision: You create an illusion visible only to the target that draws on its deepest fears. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.allucinazione.options.infest: The target must succeed on a WIL (Resolve) saving throw or believe it is covered in insects crawling on its skin and between its clothes. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.allucinazione.options.fantas: The target must make an INT (Composure) saving throw. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.alterazione_corporea.summary: You psionically modify your body. (CRB p. 160)
data.powers.alterazione_corporea.increme: For each psi point spent in addition to the total base cost, you increase the power’s maximum duration by 1 hour, or extend the power’s benefits to a willing creature you can touch. (CRB p. 160)
data.powers.alterazione_corporea.options: You can breathe water and gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed. (CRB p. 160)
You adapt your body to the atmospheric conditions you find yourself in. (CRB p. 160)
You are immune to the effects of extreme temperatures. (CRB p. 160)
You develop a natural weapon of your choice, such as claws, fangs, horns or the like. (CRB p. 160)
You take on a frightful appearance, with bestial or monstrous features, and gain advantage on WIL (Intimidation) checks. (CRB p. 160)
Choose one of your abilities among Fortitude, Dexterity and Perception. (CRB p. 160)
You transform your outward appearance, including height, weight, facial features, voice, hair length, skin color and any other peculiarity you wish. (CRB p. 160)
Your walking speed (and any other speed you have, such as swimming or flying) increases by 3 meters and you can jump twice the normal distance. (CRB p. 160)
Your skin becomes tough and rough. (CRB p. 160)
You gain resistance to one damage type of your choice among kinetic, energy, biotic and psychic. (CRB p. 160)
You gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed and can move easily on sloped or vertical surfaces, or hanging upside down from the ceiling. (CRB p. 160)
data.powers.alterazione_temporale.summar: You alter the flow of time for up to three creatures of your choice within range (including yourself). (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.alterazione_temporale.increm: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can affect one additional creature within range. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.alterazione_temporale.option: For the duration, the targets double their speed, gain a +2 bonus to Defense, gain advantage on their DEX saving throws and can take one additional action during each of their turns. (CRB p. 162)
For the duration, the targets are slowed, can’t take reactions, suffer a −2 penalty to Defense and have disadvantage on their Dexterity saving throws. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.anomalia_dimensionale.summar: You warp the fabric of reality, creating points of contact with other dimensions. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.anomalia_dimensionale.increm: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can increase the sphere’s radius by 3 meters or raise the power’s damage category by one. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.anomalia_dimensionale.option: The sphere is made of impenetrable darkness and is filled with a cacophony of incomprehensible noises. (CRB p. 162)
The sphere is transparent but inside it the fabric of reality is frayed and the laws of physics fluctuate dangerously. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.anomalia_gravitazionale.summ: You use your psionic abilities to manipulate the force of gravity. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.anomalia_gravitazionale.opti: You choose a creature visible within range and increase the gravity affecting it, crushing it under its own weight. (CRB p. 162)
You create a small gravitational singularity at a visible point of your choice within range, which pulls toward itself anything within a 3-meter radius of it. (CRB p. 162)
For the duration, you invert gravity in a cylinder with a 10-meter radius and 30 meters high, centered on a point you can see within range. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.barriera_telecinetica.summar: You create tangible barriers of telekinetic force. (CRB p. 164)
data.powers.barriera_telecinetica.option: Choose a creature you can see within range (including yourself). (CRB p. 164)
You interpose a barrier of telekinetic force between yourself and a creature of your choice within range. (CRB p. 164)
You create a vertical barrier made of blades of telekinetic force, which materializes from a point of your choice within range and remains for the duration. (CRB p. 164)
You create an invisible barrier of telekinetic force that materializes from a point of your choice within range and remains for the duration. (CRB p. 164)
data.powers.camuffamento.summary: Choose a creature you can see within range (including yourself) and create an illusion that masks its appearance. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.camuffamento.increment.summa: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can target one additional creature within range and the maximum duration increases by 1 hour. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.camuffamento.options.aspetto: You change the target’s appearance, including that of its clothes and the equipment it carries. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.camuffamento.options.sfocatu: For the duration, the target’s image becomes blurred and indistinct, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls made against it. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.camuffamento.options.aspetto: You make the target appear larger, more imposing and more threatening. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.camuffamento.options.invisib: The target becomes invisible for the duration. (CRB p. 158)
The target becomes invisible and stays that way for the duration, even if it attacks, damages or otherwise affects other creatures with an attack, a psionic power or another ability. (CRB p. 158)
data.powers.colpo_potenziato.summary: You store psionic power in a weapon you wield (or one of your natural weapons), releasing it when you hit with it. (CRB p. 164)
data.powers.colpo_potenziato.increment.s: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the power’s damage increases by one category. (CRB p. 164)
data.powers.colpo_potenziato.options.col: The first time you hit with a weapon attack before the power ends, the attack deals an additional 1d6 psychic damage and the target must succeed on an INT (Composure) saving throw or be sickened until the power ends. (CRB p. 164)
The first time you hit with a weapon attack before the power ends, the attack deals an additional 1d10 kinetic damage, producing a strong shockwave. (CRB p. 164)

The first time you hit with a weapon attack before the power ends, the attack deals an additional 1d6 biotic damage and the target must succeed on a FRT (Endurance) saving throw or be slowed until the power ends. (CRB p. 164)
The first time you hit with a weapon attack before the power ends, the attack deals an additional 1d8 energy damage, emitting a bright flash of light. (CRB p. 164)
data.powers.comprensione_psionica.summar: You use your psionic gifts to broaden your communication abilities. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.comprensione_psionica.option: For the duration, you gain the ability to understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear or any written language you see. (CRB p. 168)
For the duration, you gain the ability to understand and communicate verbally with animals. (CRB p. 168)
For the duration, you gain the ability to learn information from plants within 10 meters of you. (CRB p. 168)

When you manifest this power and as an action during each of your later turns until the duration ends, you can focus your attention on a creature you can see and hear within 10 meters of you. (CRB p. 168)

When you manifest this power and as an action during each of your later turns until the duration ends, you can make contact with a stone (natural or worked) and instantly learn who or what has touched it in the last 10 days, as well as reveal what is hidden behind, beneath or inside it. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.conoscenze_psioniche.summary: Your psychic abilities grant you glimpses of knowledge you could not otherwise have. (CRB p. 169)
data.powers.conoscenze_psioniche.options: Choose a skill you do not have. (CRB p. 169)
When you manifest this power you gain information about the surrounding territory within 1 km of you outdoors or within 100 meters of you in underground environments. (CRB p. 169)
You name or describe an important person, creature, object or place. (CRB p. 169)
data.powers.contatto_telepatico.summary: You expand your thoughts to communicate telepathically with the minds of other creatures. (CRB p. 166)
You create a telepathic bond with a willing creature within 10 meters of you. (CRB p. 166)
You target a visible creature within 10 meters of you that is able to see you, telepathically conveying your friendly intentions to it. (CRB p. 166)
You enter a sleep-like trance during which you remain aware of your surroundings, although you cannot move or take actions. (CRB p. 166)
It works like dream contact, but you appear in the creature’s dreams taking on a monstrous and terrifying appearance. (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.copie_illusorie.summary: You create illusory copies of yourself that you can make act and behave as you please. (EC p. 19)
data.powers.copie_illusorie.options.dupl: A number of illusory duplicates of yourself equal to the number of psi points spent appear in your space. (EC p. 19)
data.powers.copie_illusorie.options.sosi: You become invisible at the same moment an illusory double of you appears where you are. (EC p. 19)
It works like illusory double, but you can make the illusory duplicate appear in another place, instead of where you are. (EC p. 19)
data.powers.dominare_menti.summary: You target a creature you can see within range and bend its will to yours. (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.dominare_menti.increment.sum: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can affect one additional creature within range. (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.dominare_menti.options.coman: When you manifest this power and as an action on your later turns until it ends (maximum 1 minute), you can speak a one-word command aimed at the target and it must succeed on a WIL (Resolve) saving throw or carry out that command during its next turn. (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.dominare_menti.options.sugge: You suggest a course of activity to the target (limited to a sentence or two). (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.dominare_menti.options.domin: The target must succeed on a WIL (Resolve) saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration (maximum 1 minute). (CRB p. 166)
data.powers.enigma_linguistico.summary: Choose a point within range that you can see. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.enigma_linguistico.increment: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the maximum duration increases by 1 hour. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.enigma_linguistico.options.b: Creatures affected by the power can no longer understand others’ words, regardless of the language heard. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.enigma_linguistico.options.i: All creatures affected by the power gain the ability to communicate with each other using a language that is totally incomprehensible to the ears of any other creature. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.immagine_illusoria.summary: You create an illusion that is visible but intangible. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.immagine_illusoria.options.i: You create the image of an object, a creature or some other visible phenomenon no larger than a cube 3 meters on a side, which appears at a point you can see within range and lasts for the duration. (CRB p. 159)

As for minor image, but the illusion can fill up to a cube 6 meters on a side and seems fully real, including sounds, smells, temperature and other sensory stimuli appropriate to the thing depicted. (CRB p. 159)
As for greater image, but once the duration ends, it becomes permanent and remains until dispelled, no longer requiring your concentration. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.individuazione_psionica.summ: You focus your mind on a given subject to try to sense its presence or locate its position. (CRB p. 169)
data.powers.individuazione_psionica.incr: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the range of the power’s effects doubles. (CRB p. 169)
data.powers.individuazione_psionica.opti: When you manifest this power you think of a specific species of animal or plant. (CRB p. 169)
You hold in your hand a small sample of mineral (for example a gold ring, a quartz crystal, a gem, a fragment of iron and so on). (CRB p. 169)
For the duration, you sense the presence of any trap in your line of sight, up to a maximum distance of 10 meters. (CRB p. 169)
You designate a creature, an object or a place familiar to you as the target of this power. (CRB p. 169)
data.powers.influsso_del_comandante.summ: You focus your mental influence on the minds of your allies in order to coordinate their actions and carry out complex tactics and strategies that would otherwise be almost impossible to achieve. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.influsso_del_comandante.incr: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can target one additional creature within range. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.influsso_del_comandante.opti: Choose a creature you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
Choose up to three allies you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
Choose up to three allies you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
Choose up to two allies you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
Choose up to four allies you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
Choose up to four allied creatures you can see within range. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.instillare_compulsione.summa: Target a creature you can see within range; it must succeed on a WIL (Resolve) saving throw or suffer the effects of the power. (CRB p. 167)
data.powers.instillare_compulsione.incre: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can affect one additional creature within range. (CRB p. 167)
data.powers.instillare_compulsione.optio: The target becomes unable to speak intelligibly. (CRB p. 167)
The target feels an irrepressible urge to laugh out loud. (CRB p. 167)
The target falls asleep and collapses unconscious for the duration. (CRB p. 167)
You point to a creature within range that the target can perceive, and the target will feel a strong attraction to it. (CRB p. 167)
You point to a creature within range that the target can perceive, and the target will feel a terrible repulsion toward it. (CRB p. 167)
You instill a mad, murderous fury in the target. (CRB p. 167)
The target starts a comical dance on the spot. (CRB p. 167)
data.powers.instillare_emozione.summary: Target a creature you can see within range; it must succeed on a WIL (Resolve) saving throw or suffer the effects of the power. (CRB p. 167)
data.powers.instillare_emozione.incremen: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can affect one additional creature within range. (CRB p. 167)
The target is charmed by you for the duration (maximum 1 hour) or until you or your allies do something hostile to it. (CRB p. 167)
The target is infused with courage. (CRB p. 167)
The target feels a strong resentment toward you. (CRB p. 167)
The target falls prey to depression. (CRB p. 167)
For the duration (maximum 10 minutes), you suppress any effect that makes the target charmed or frightened, as well as any emotional state that could trouble it. (CRB p. 167)
The target is frightened by you for the duration (maximum 1 minute). (CRB p. 167)
data.powers.levitazione_telecinetica.sum: You use telekinesis to oppose the force of gravity, controlling the speed of a fall or lifting yourself and other creatures into the air. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.levitazione_telecinetica.inc: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can affect one additional creature within range or raise by one category the maximum size of the creatures that can be affected. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.levitazione_telecinetica.opt: Choose up to five Medium or smaller creatures you can see within range that are falling (including yourself). (CRB p. 165)
Choose a Medium or smaller creature or object you can see within range (including yourself). (CRB p. 165)
Choose a Medium or smaller creature you can see within range (including yourself). (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.manipolare_luce.summary: You use your psychopower to manipulate light. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.manipolare_luce.increment.su: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the maximum duration of this power doubles and the radius of its area of effect increases by 3 meters. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.manipolare_luce.options.alon: For the duration, all objects within a 3-meter radius of the chosen point are surrounded by a luminous halo (of a color of your choice) that emits dim light within a 3-meter radius. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.manipolare_luce.options.luce: For the duration, light or darkness, as you choose, radiates from the chosen point. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.manipolare_luce.options.bagl: A series of dazzling lights bursts from the chosen point, filling a sphere with a 3-meter radius. (CRB p. 159)
data.powers.manipolazione_energetica.sum: You use telekinesis to manipulate electromagnetic energy. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.manipolazione_energetica.inc: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the power’s damage increases by one category. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.manipolazione_energetica.opt: A crackling bolt of energy bursts from your hand, shooting toward a visible creature of your choice within range. (CRB p. 165)
You create three rays of radiant energy and project them toward visible targets of your choice within range. (CRB p. 165)
You create a beam of radiant energy extending from you in a line 1 meter wide and 20 meters long. (CRB p. 165)
A blast of radiant energy fills an area with a 10-meter radius centered on a point of your choice within range, dispelling any darkness, both psionic and natural. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.manipolazione_sonica.summary: You use your telekinetic abilities to manipulate sound waves. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.manipolazione_sonica.options: A thundering wave projects from you in all directions, creating a rumble audible hundreds of meters away. (EC p. 20)
A powerful, very high-pitched and intense sonic vibration erupts from a point of your choice within range. (EC p. 20)
Choose a point within range and create a sphere with a maximum radius of 6 meters centered on that point. (EC p. 20)
Choose a point within range and create a sphere with a maximum radius of 6 meters centered on that point. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.manipolazione_telecinetica.s: You use telekinesis to move or manipulate objects or creatures. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.manipolazione_telecinetica.o: Choose one or more unattended objects of Small or smaller size that you can see within range, up to a maximum number equal to the psi points spent. (CRB p. 165)

When you manifest this power and as an action during each of your later turns until the duration ends, you can make a ranged psionic attack against a creature or object you can see within range, hurling a pulse of telekinetic force. (CRB p. 165)

When you manifest this power and as an action during each of your later turns until the duration ends, you can target a Medium or smaller creature or object you can see within range, seizing it with your telekinetic force. (CRB p. 165)
data.powers.percezioni_psioniche.summary: You target a creature you are in contact with (including yourself) and psionically alter its sensory perceptions. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.percezioni_psioniche.increme: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can choose one additional creature as a target. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.percezioni_psioniche.options: For the duration, the target perceives the presence of psionic activity within 10 meters of itself. (CRB p. 170)
For the duration, the target develops a surprising attention to detail and gains advantage on all its Perception checks. (CRB p. 170)
For the duration, the target can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible. (CRB p. 170)
For the duration, you can use your action to see through the target’s eyes and hear what it can hear, continuing to do so until you decide to return to your normal senses. (CRB p. 170)
For the duration, the target can see things as they truly are, gaining ultravision. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.premonizione.summary: You expand your mind to try to catch glimpses of the future. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.premonizione.options.preavvi: You manifest the power by touching a willing creature (including yourself). (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.premonizione.options.presagi: You receive an omen about the result of a specific course of action you intend to take in the next 30 minutes. (CRB p. 170)
You can ask the GM one question about a specific goal, event or activity that is to occur within 6 days, plus one additional day for each psi point spent in addition to the base cost. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.premonizione.options.profezi: You open your mind to probe the flow of time and glean fragments of it. (CRB p. 170)
data.powers.prosciugamento_biopsionico.s: You use your psychic power to assail the metabolism of creatures. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.prosciugamento_biopsionico.i: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can target one additional creature within range or (where relevant) raise the power’s damage by one category. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.prosciugamento_biopsionico.o: Target a creature of your choice that you can see within range. (EC p. 20)
Target a creature of your choice that you can see within range. (EC p. 20)

On the turn you manifest the power and then as an action during your later turns until its duration ends, you can make a ranged psionic attack against a creature of your choice within range. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.rigenerazione_biopsionica.su: You place a hand in contact with a creature of your choice (including yourself), psionically stimulating the regeneration of its body. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.rigenerazione_biopsionica.op: For the duration, the target recovers 1 vitality point every minute and spontaneously heals from the non-permanent effects of traumas over 1d6+2 hours. (CRB p. 161)

For the duration, the target recovers 1 vitality point at the start of each of its turns and spontaneously heals from the non-permanent effects of traumas over 1d6+2 minutes, and from permanent ones in 1d6+2 hours. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.risanamento_biopsionico.summ: You place a hand in contact with a creature of your choice (including yourself) and use your psychopower to restore its state of health. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.risanamento_biopsionico.opti: You probe the target’s body and learn one piece of information of your choice from the following for each psi point spent: • The creature’s current and maximum vitality points, as well as the damage types it has recently suffered. (CRB p. 161)
The target recovers an amount of vitality points equal to 1d6 for each psi point spent. (CRB p. 161)
You remove from the target one condition afflicting it among dazzled, blinded, deafened, sickened, paralyzed, slowed, bleeding, stunned. (CRB p. 161)
You remove 1 exhaustion level from the target. (CRB p. 161)
You manifest this power by touching a creature that died no more than 1 minute ago, plus one additional minute for each psi point spent in addition to the base cost. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.sensori_psionici.summary: You create one or more floating sensors made of psionic force, invisible and totally intangible (they can’t be attacked or interacted with). (EC p. 21)
data.powers.sensori_psionici.increment.s: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the power’s range and duration double. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.sensori_psionici.options.sen: You create a sensor at a location within range. (EC p. 21)
It works like static sensor, but the sensor you create has infravision and you can use an action to move it up to 10 meters in any direction. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.sensori_psionici.options.occ: You create up to 10 sensors (called “eyes”) that watch over or explore the surrounding territory, reporting back to you according to the instructions you specify when you manifest the power. (EC p. 21)
data.powers.sonda_mentale.summary: You expand your mind, gaining the ability to perceive others’ thoughts. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.sonda_mentale.increment.summ: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the power’s maximum duration doubles. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.sonda_mentale.options.percep: When you manifest this power and as an action on each of your later turns until it ends, you can target a creature of your choice that you can see within range. (CRB p. 168)
When you manifest this power and as an action on your later turns until it ends, you can expand your mind to perceive other thinking minds within a radius equal to the power’s range. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.sonda_mentale.options.sondar: You target the body of a creature that died no more than 3 days ago, probing what remains of its mind. (CRB p. 168)
Target a creature of your choice that you can see within range. (CRB p. 168)
data.powers.spazio_extra_dimensionale.su: You manipulate the fabric of reality, creating space where there is none. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.spazio_extra_dimensionale.in: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, the power’s duration doubles. (EC p. 20)
data.powers.spazio_extra_dimensionale.op: You create a small extra-dimensional space that lasts for 24 hours. (EC p. 20)
You create an extra-dimensional space that lasts for 1 hour and is large enough to hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. (EC p. 20)
You create a cylindrical tunnel of extra-dimensional space that opens at a visible point of your choice within range, located on a solid surface (such as a wall, floor or ceiling). (EC p. 20)
data.powers.teletrasporto.summary: You create a spacetime portal connecting the place where you are with another place of your choice. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.teletrasporto.increment.summ: For each psi point spent in addition to the base cost, you can roll the d100 twice and use the result you prefer. (CRB p. 162)
data.powers.traslazione.summary: You warp spacetime, annulling distances to move instantly from one place to another. (CRB p. 163)
data.powers.traslazione.options.traslazi: As a minor action, you teleport from your current position to an unoccupied space you can see within 12 meters, plus an additional 4 meters for each psi point spent in addition to the base cost. (CRB p. 163)

As a minor action, you teleport from your current position to an unoccupied space you can see within 8 meters of you, plus an additional 4 meters for each psi point spent in addition to the base cost. (CRB p. 163)
As an action, choose a Small or Medium creature you can see within 12 meters of you, plus another 4 meters for each psi point spent in addition to the base cost. (CRB p. 163)
Choose up to five willing Large or smaller creatures you can see within 6 meters of you. (CRB p. 163)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.summary: You use your psychopower to protect yourself and your allies. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.p: An emanation of biotic energy bursts from you for a brief instant. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.f: You increase the vitality and toughness of your allies. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.l: You manifest this power by touching a creature. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.a: Purifying energy radiates within a 6-meter radius of you. (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.p: You manifest this power by touching a creature (including yourself). (CRB p. 161)
data.powers.tutela_biopsionica.options.b: A barrier of biotic energy extends out to a 3-meter radius around you, moving with you and staying centered on you. (CRB p. 161)
data.items.arnesi_da_lavoro_pesante.summ: A set of tools designed for heavy carpentry work and also used to force open and break open doors, containers and various seals. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.kit_di_intrusione.summary: Includes an assortment of tools designed to tamper with mechanical and electronic devices, locks, traps, alarms and other security systems, and to carry out computer intrusions and breaches. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.kit_da_truffatore.summary: Includes everything needed to make cosmetics, disguises and visual camouflage, as well as substances, tools and materials needed to create forged documents, both physical and digital. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.omnitool.summary: An advanced technological device that can perform a wide range of tasks. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.set_da_gioco_vari.summary: This entry includes a wide range of game tools (including, for example, classic dice and decks of cards), usable to take part in an equally wide variety of board games and gambling games. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.strumenti_medicali.summary: Includes hypojet injectors, dressing materials, generic medicines, surgical instruments and anything else useful to the medical profession. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.strumenti_musicali_vari.summa: This entry includes every kind of musical instrument, usable with the Music skill. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.strumenti_scientifici.summary: Includes vials, slides, swabs, reagents, reaction catalysts and all the instruments needed to carry out scientific investigations and experiments, including the collection, analysis and creation of substances and materials. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.strumenti_tecnici.summary: Includes a wide assortment of tools and utensils used for mechanical and electrical work, such as manufacturing, disassembling, reassembling, modifying and repairing any type of equipment or technological device. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.abbigliamento_comune_provocan: This entry includes all ordinary items of everyday clothing. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.cavo_d_acciaio.summary: Can support a load of 5,000 w. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.cavo_in_nanofibra.summary: As strong as a steel cable, but as flexible and light as an ordinary rope. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.credichip.summary: Credichips are the most common digital medium for money, in a society where monetary transactions are almost exclusively electronic. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.cinturone_tattico.summary: A very useful belt fitted with pockets, hooks and containers. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.estintore.summary: A canister of chemical fire-suppressant foam sufficient to smother flames in a 3x3 meter area. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.fune.summary: Rope of braided synthetic fibers. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.lampada_elettrica.summary: An electric lamp projects bright light in a 10-meter radius and dim light for an additional 10 meters. (CRB p. 113)
data.items.manette_standard.summary: Standard handcuffs can be applied to Medium or Small creatures. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.nastro_adesivo.summary: Strong adhesive tape able to hold up to 80 w of load (beyond which it has a 50% chance of breaking at the end of each round). (CRB p. 114)
data.items.occhiali_protettivi.summary: Glasses fitted with dark lenses. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.rampino.summary: Tied to a rope, it can be thrown to secure the rope to branches, ledges or similar holds. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.scala_a_pioli.summary: A simple ladder of rope and aluminum rungs, fitted with metal hooks at one end. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.serratura.summary: A simple mechanical locking device. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.torcia_chimica.summary: A 15 cm tube filled with a photochemical product. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.torcia_elettrica.summary: Produces a conical beam of light about 30 degrees wide. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.generatore_fotoelettrico.summ: A portable generator that converts sunlight into energy. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.nucleo_a_microfusione_mfc.sum: A miniaturized cold fusion reactor, capable of supplying a total energy equivalent to 20 ENC cells. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.unita_di_ricarica.summary: When connected to an external power source (such as generators, power grids, etc.), this device can recharge up to 5 ENC cells in about 1 hour. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.g_comp.summary: Creates a small gravitational disturbance field that surrounds the user and modifies gravity as needed, lowering gravity that is too high or raising gravity that is too low, compensating up to a maximum of ±0.5 g. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.g_pulse.summary: A small gravitational repulsion generator, similar to the engines of planetary vehicles but less powerful. (CRB p. 114)
data.items.occultatore.summary: Creates an optical distortion field around the user, making them invisible both to sight and to most sensors. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.scudo_deflettore_2.summary: Creates a protective field around the user capable of deflecting incoming attacks, granting a +2 bonus to Defense. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.soppressore_acustico.summary: Creates an acoustic suppression field that cancels any sound within a 6-meter radius. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.binocolo_telemetrico.summary: Allows you to see at great distances with a magnification factor of up to 30x. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.multiscanner.summary: A device able to detect a wide range of environmental data such as temperature, pressure, radiation and atmospheric composition, as well as analyze materials, substances and energy emissions. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.rilevatore.summary: When active, this device scans the surrounding environment in a 20-meter radius, detecting the general layout of explorable spaces (the course of walls and obstacles, the shape of rooms and empty spaces, etc.) and displaying an approximate floor plan on a small screen. (CRB p. 115)
data.items.tecnosonda.summary: A small diagnostic tool that can be connected to any electronic or computer device to analyze its internal structure and detect any malfunctions. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.visore.summary: A visor is an eyepiece device (worn like glasses) that projects a wide range of information from other devices or computer networks directly into the user’s field of vision. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.ad_suit.summary: An Atmospheric Diving Suit is a complex and heavy pressurized underwater suit with variable buoyancy. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.attrezzatura_da_immersione.su: Includes mask, wetsuit, buoyancy vest, fins, barometer. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.attrezzatura_da_scalata.summa: Includes harness, carabiners, ice axes, crampons, climbing pitons and anything else useful for climbing and equipping fixed routes. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.attrezzatura_da_sopravvivenza: An assortment of useful tools including lighter, flint and tinder, needle and thread, compass, pickaxe, shovel, hacksaw and telescopic pole (3 m open, 70 cm closed). (CRB p. 116)
data.items.criocapsula.summary: A cryogenic device capable of housing a Small or Medium creature. (CRB p. 116)
data.items.depuratore_d_acqua.summary: Purifies water of any contaminating or harmful agent, making it perfectly drinkable, at a rate of 6 liters per hour. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.esotuta_cbn.summary: Exosuits are special protective garments designed to protect against various types of environmental hazards. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.kit_di_primo_soccorso.summary: Contains everything needed to administer first aid. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.paracadute.summary: Prevents fall damage but is ineffective for falls of less than 15 meters (too short to allow it to open). (CRB p. 117)
data.items.razione_alimentare.summary: Highly nutritious freeze-dried food suited to be eaten while traveling or on a mission. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.respiratore.summary: A filtering device that protects against atmospheric hazards such as airborne pathogens and poisons, fumes and harmful gases. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.respiratore_subacqueo.summary: A device similar to a diving mask, able to extract oxygen from water in a way similar to gills, allowing the user to breathe underwater for an unlimited period of time. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.saccoletto_standard.summary: A standard sleeping bag is comfortable down to about -15° C. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.sterilizzatore.summary: A device able to generate a beam of ultraviolet radiation sufficient to sterilize the surface it is passed over. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.stivali_magnetici.summary: Boots fitted with magnetic soles that can be activated on command. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.tenda_standard.summary: A portable shelter made of a modular frame covered with insulating fabric. (CRB p. 117)
VSU (Vital Support Unit) units are small pressurized cylinders containing a breathable atmosphere and everything needed to provide life support to a creature for 24 hours. (CRB p. 117)
data.items.computer_n.summary: A computer’s power is represented by a number indicating its class (computer/1, computer/2, etc.). (CRB p. 120)
data.items.datapad_n.summary: A datapad is a lightweight, small “handheld” computer, made of a tablet whose upper surface is a touch screen. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.database_0.summary: A database is simply a large collection of searchable information concerning a specific subject. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.interfaccia_0.summary: The interface is the basic program that allows the user to interact easily with a computer. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.intrusione_n.summary: Intrusion programs are generally illegal. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.iv_n.summary: Virtual intelligences (abbreviated VI) are highly sophisticated programs developed to make computer systems more autonomous. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.qualifica_n.summary: Skill programs consist of a set of data and algorithms that imitate characters’ skills. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.protezione_0.summary: Protection programs defend computers from intrusions, setting the DC of the TEC (Computers) checks needed to breach them. (CRB p. 120)
data.items.cavi_di_interfaccia.summary: Typical cables used to connect computerized devices to each other or to cybernetic interface jacks. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.codificatore.summary: A small electronic device able to encrypt the data contained in any computer device it is connected to, so that it can be decrypted only by possessing the specific decryption code of that encoder. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.comlink.summary: A personal multimedia communication device able to exchange data across telecommunication networks. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.datachip.summary: This is the most common physical medium for storing digital data (such as databases, programs, images, videos, audio files, etc.). (CRB p. 121)
data.items.disturbatore_di_frequenze.sum: An effective device able to block the signal of any communication apparatus. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.microspia.summary: A miniaturized device able to send position signals and audio-video data to a device set up to receive them (comlink, datapad or computer). (CRB p. 121)
data.items.olorecorder.summary: An audio-video recording and playback device in holographic format, about the size of an apple. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.omni_traduttore.summary: This sophisticated and expensive device allows you to communicate verbally regardless of the language used. (CRB p. 121)
data.items.drone_sentinella.summary: A small drone fitted with various sensor systems and basic self-defense capabilities. (CRB p. 123)
data.items.automa_civile_mansioni_generi: This is the most common type of civilian robot. (CRB p. 123)
data.items.automa_di_sicurezza.summary: A basic model of robotic soldier, widely used in war, public order and police operations. (CRB p. 123)
data.items.nas.summary: The NAS is a sensor able to pick up the neural activity of sentient creatures. (EC p. 24)
data.items.psicocristallo.summary: These rare natural crystals have the unusual property of interacting with psionic energies. (EC p. 24)
A set of 20 motion sensors fitted with an acoustic alarm. (EC p. 24)
data.items.sistema_icarus.summary: This device lets the user avoid fall damage thanks to a strong electromagnetic pulse it emits just before impact with the ground, slowing the fall. (EC p. 24)
data.items.tintura_fosforescente.summary: One jar of this dye is enough to cover an object or creature of Medium size or smaller, or a total surface of about 2 square meters. (EC p. 24)
data.items.torcia.summary: A torch is a simple stick with fibers soaked in flammable material such as resin, bitumen or wax wrapped around its upper end. (EC p. 24)
data.items.trappola_da_caccia.summary: You can set this trap using an action. (EC p. 24)
data.items.triboli.summary: A bag containing small metal spikes with four points arranged so that one always faces upward. (EC p. 24)
data.items.unf.summary: A substance made of a cloud of interconnected nanites that changes shape and properties to form simple macroscopic objects, responding to commands sent by software through an omnitool, datapad or computer. (EC p. 24)
data.items.coltello.summary: A weapon with a small blade, suited to close combat. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.coltello_tattico.summary: A military knife designed for close combat but also as a survival tool. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.frusta.summary: A whip can be used to attempt to disarm or unbalance, but it can’t be used to attack adjacent opponents. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.lancia_lunga.summary: This weapon can’t be used against adjacent enemies. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.ololama.summary: A weapon made of a handle about 30 cm long for the standard version and about 150 cm for the polearm version. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.cerbottana.summary: An archaic weapon used to silently fire darts, often coated with poison or sleeping agents. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.fucile_a_dardi.summary: A weapon suited to firing darts, often coated with poison or sleeping agents. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.rete.summary: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it frees itself. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.shotgun.summary: Shotguns offer poor accuracy but fearsome offensive power at short range. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.fucile_di_precisione.summary: Designed to hit targets at long distance, this type of rifle already comes with an optical sight. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.taser.summary: A small weapon designed to incapacitate targets. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.proiettore_ad_arco.summary: A heavy weapon able to generate a powerful electric discharge similar to lightning. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.raggio_protonico.summary: This powerful weapon emits a beam of protons accelerated to nearly the speed of light which, thanks to its enormous energy, ignores any resistance to energy damage. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.bolas.summary: A thrown weapon made of two or three spheres about 10 cm across tied together with cords. (EC p. 22)
data.items.boomerang.summary: A thrown weapon made of a curved, flattened stick. (EC p. 22)
data.items.lanciarazzi.summary: A weapon for launching explosive rockets, made of a shoulder-carried launch tube into which the rocket is inserted, its motor then being activated by the weapon’s trigger. (EC p. 22)
data.items.fulminatore_em.summary: A carbine-like weapon that fires electric discharges. (EC p. 22)
data.items.lanciafiamme.summary: A flamethrower projects a jet of flame, creating an area attack that originates from the weapon and takes the shape of a line 20 meters long and 1 meter wide. (EC p. 22)
data.items.scudo.summary: A shield is carried by means of a grip and straps that secure it to the forearm. (CRB p. 106)
data.items.scudo_balistico.summary: A rectangular shield 1.5 meters tall. (CRB p. 106)
data.items.dardi.summary: Conical darts ending in a metal needle, used with blowguns and dart rifles. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.frecce.summary: Projectiles used with bows and crossbows. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.enc.summary: High-efficiency batteries used to power kinetic and energy weapons (see “Portable Energy Sources”, further on). (CRB p. 110)
data.items.plastimetallo.summary: A special ductile metal that hardens when subjected to strong acceleration. (CRB p. 110)
data.items.chiodi.summary: Simple metal nails that can be fired with a nail gun. (EC p. 22)
data.items.propellente.summary: An incendiary mixture used as ammunition for the flamethrower. (EC p. 22)
data.items.razzo_frammentazione.summary: When it explodes, it throws metal fragments in all directions. (EC p. 22)
data.items.razzo_impulsi_em.summary: Generates a strong electromagnetic pulse. (EC p. 22)
data.items.razzo_incendiario.summary: Generates a blast of flames that sets fire to a 6-meter-radius area for 1 minute. (EC p. 22)
data.items.razzo_plasma.summary: Generates a powerful plasma detonation. (EC p. 22)
data.items.acido_fiala.summary: With an action, you can hurl the vial at a target within close range, shattering it on impact. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.antidolorifici.summary: Taking a dose of painkillers lets you ignore (where possible) the negative effects of physical traumas for 2d3+2 hours (see “Traumas” in Chapter 2). (CRB p. 118)
data.items.antitossina.summary: Ingesting a dose of antitoxin grants advantage on saving throws against poisons for 1 hour. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.collirio_dell_infravisione.su: By applying a dose of these eye drops to the eyes, a creature gains infravision for 8 hours. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.contraccettivo.summary: A substance that inhibits conception following sexual intercourse. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.exorad.summary: A drug that cures radiation poisoning. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.feromoni_sintetici.summary: A small vial containing a colorless liquid with synthetic pheromones. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.medipac_standard.summary: Medipacs are single-use hypojet vials containing a mix of antibiotic, painkilling and stimulant substances. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.pelle_spray.summary: A spray bottle containing synthetic epithelial cells and coagulating substances. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.polvere_soffocante.summary: A powder able to block the respiratory system of whoever inhales it. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.radiox.summary: Developed in the military sphere to protect soldiers from radiation. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.siero_dell_anfibio.summary: By taking a dose of this serum, a creature gains the ability to breathe water for 1 hour. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.siero_morte_apparente.summary: By taking a dose of this serum, a creature enters a state of feigned death. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.siero_della_verita.summary: This serum is administered by injection (hypojet). (CRB p. 118)
data.items.speedheal.summary: An experimental healing drug, illegal because of its side effects. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.veleno_base_fiala.summary: Besides being administrable by ingestion or injection, a dose of this poison is enough to poison the blade of a weapon or up to three darts or arrows. (CRB p. 118)
data.items.aion.summary: A very rare and very expensive drug able to slow aging. (EC p. 24)
data.items.nano_anticorpi.summary: An expensive nanotechnological drug taken through a hypojet vial. (EC p. 25)
data.items.neurodeprina.summary: A drug developed to inhibit the effects of cyber-psychosis caused by implanting cyberware. (EC p. 25)
data.items.omni_gel.summary: A bluish resin-like substance made of repair nanites suspended in a gelatinous suspension of metallic and polymer molecules. (EC p. 25)
data.items.polvere_curativa.summary: A powder based on herbs and other natural substances. (EC p. 25)
data.items.sedativi_leggeri.summary: Substances with mild painkilling, anti-nausea and calming properties (such as cannabis and chamomile). (EC p. 25)
data.items.stimolanti_leggeri.summary: Substances able to dull sensations of hunger, fatigue and sleepiness (such as caffeine and nicotine). (EC p. 25)
data.items.voodoo.summary: A mildly psychotropic substance of natural origin. (EC p. 25)
data.items.detonatore.summary: A device for triggering explosive material. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.mina_frag.summary: These are small placeable devices, easily concealed and fitted with proximity sensors. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.rex.summary: A powerful semi-solid explosive mixture with a waxy consistency. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.granata_frag.summary: When it explodes, it throws metal fragments in all directions. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.granata_gas.summary: This device emits a cloud of irritant gas that produces an obscured area with a 6-meter radius around the point where it explodes. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.granata_impulsi_em.summary: Generates a strong electromagnetic (EM) pulse. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.granata_plasma.summary: Generates a powerful plasma detonation. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.granata_stordente.summary: A non-lethal device designed to incapacitate targets. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.lanciagranate_singolo.summary: A grenade launcher is considered a two-handed kinetic weapon. (CRB p. 112)
data.items.molotov.summary: A homemade incendiary bomb made of a glass container filled with flammable liquid with a wick sticking out of it. (EC p. 23)
data.items.dinamite.summary: A common explosive sold in the form of sticks. (EC p. 24)
data.items.granata_incendiaria.summary: Generates a blast of flames (even underwater). (EC p. 24)
data.items.granata_intralciante.summary: When it explodes, it spreads a viscous, sticky molasses all around. (EC p. 24)
data.items.armatura_improvvisata.summary: Improvised armors are makeshift protections, often self-built and made by assembling salvaged materials. (CRB p. 105)
data.rules.shield_attack.summary: Shields can be used as melee weapons that deal 1d4 kinetic damage. (CRB p. 105)
data.cyberware.artigli_e_nocche_di_biome: Thanks to these biometal implants that reinforce the knuckles and nails of the hand, when you attack with an unarmed strike using your hands you deal 1d6 kinetic damage instead of 1d4 as normal. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.biomonitor.summary: A small subdermal chip usually implanted in the forearm or the palm of the hand. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.endolink.summary: A telecommunication device implanted in the skull and connected directly to the auditory and vocal apparatus. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.filtri_nasali.summary: Grant advantage on saving throws made against the effects of gases, fumes, inhaled poisons, airborne pathogens and other harmful substances in the air. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.meta_tatuaggio_per_area_d: Although at first glance they might look like ordinary tattoos, meta-tattoos can emit a faint luminescence and are able to disappear and reappear, change color and even change shape and design while remaining roughly the same size, all at the wearer’s will. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.modulatore_vocale.summary: Allows precise control of vocal tone, timbre and inflection. (CRB p. 124)
data.cyberware.mutairidi.summary: Nanotechnological irises able to change color and become luminescent at the wearer’s will. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.nanocapelli.summary: Nanotechnological hair able to change color, diameter, length and style, as well as become luminescent, all at the wearer’s will. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.impianto_neurale.summary: A micro-computer grafted onto the cerebral cortex that acts as a cybernetic interface. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.amplificatore_di_reazione: You have advantage on initiative rolls, unless you are surprised. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.coprocessore_di_interazio: You have advantage on saving throws against effects that make you charmed and on Willpower checks made to influence an interlocutor’s attitude during social interactions. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.focalizzatore_di_attenzio: You have advantage on checks made to maintain concentration. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.inibitore_di_paura.summar: You have advantage on saving throws against effects that make you frightened. (CRB p. 125)
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that make you stunned. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.cyber_arto.summary: A cybernetic prosthesis that replaces a natural limb, providing the same functions. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.arma_integrata.summary: The cyber-limb incorporates a “retractable” weapon chosen from the following: war sword, holoblade or any pistol or submachine gun. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.colpo_potenziato.summary: If used as a melee unarmed strike, the cyber-limb deals 1d8 kinetic damage instead of 1d6. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.rivestimento_dermico.summ: A synthetic dermis covering that makes the cyber-limb look like a natural one. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.scomparto.summary: A compartment able to hold a small weapon, such as a knife or a pistol. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.cyber_ottica.summary: A cybernetic ocular implant that replaces the eyes, providing the same functions. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.cyber_udito.summary: A cybernetic implant that replaces the inner auditory apparatus, providing the same functions. (CRB p. 125)
data.cyberware.cuore.summary: A biosynthetic heart grants the following benefits. (CRB p. 126)
data.cyberware.polmoni.summary: Biosynthetic lungs grant the following benefits. (CRB p. 126)
data.cyberware.stomaco.summary: A biosynthetic stomach grants the following benefits. (CRB p. 126)
data.cyberware.bio_incremento.summary: Enhances one of your abilities. (CRB p. 126)
data.cyberware.bio_regolazione.summary: Optimizes your biological functions and boosts your immune system. (CRB p. 126)
data.cyberware.poliderma.summary: Alters the structure of your skin, making it tough and chameleon-like. (CRB p. 126)
data.enhancements.compatta.summary: The weapon weighs 10% less than normal, is more compact and folds up taking less space when not in use. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.cyberlink.summary: The weapon can be connected to a visor or cyber-optics with an ATS function (see “Sensors”, further on). (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.danno_potenziato.summa: Increases the weapon’s offensive power, granting a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with it. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.difensiva.summary: The weapon is particularly suited to parrying and deflecting enemy blows. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.dissipatore_termico.su: Improves the weapon’s heat dissipation. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.folgorante.summary: This enhancement fits the weapon with a series of electrodes that release a strong electric discharge when it hits, dealing +1d6 energy damage in addition to the weapon’s normal damage. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.identificativa.summary: An electronic locking system synchronized to an individual’s genetic code. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.munizioni_esplosive.su: This enhancement fits the weapon with a system that inserts an explosive substance into plastimetal projectiles. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.munizioni_traccianti.s: This enhancement fits the weapon with a system that inserts into plastimetal projectiles a pyrotechnic substance that leaves a thin luminous trail along the line of fire. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.precisione.summary: Improves the weapon’s stability and accuracy, granting a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with it. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.ricarica_migliorata.su: Makes reloading the weapon a minor action, instead of an action. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.scomponibile.summary: The weapon can be easily disassembled and assembled, taking 1 action. (CRB p. 111)
data.enhancements.lacci_di_sicurezza.sum: They allow the weapon’s grip to be secured to the wrist, granting advantage on any roll made to avoid being disarmed (see Chapter 2). (CRB p. 110)
data.enhancements.mirino_laser.summary: Using a laser sight increases by 1 the bonus gained when using the Aim minor action. (CRB p. 110)
data.enhancements.mirino_ottico.summary: A telescopic sight fitted with an adjustable reticle and magnification up to 10x. (CRB p. 110)
data.enhancements.silenziatore.summary: A device attachable to the barrel of kinetic weapons. (CRB p. 110)
data.enhancements.ablativa.summary: The Armor Value granted by the armor applies fully to energy damage as well. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.adattativa.summary: A series of special joints and polymorphic materials allow the armor to adapt to the wearer’s anatomy. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.agevole.summary: The penalty caused by the armor is reduced by 1 (down to a minimum of 0). (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.amplificazione_sensori: Incorporates into the armor a dense network of micro-sensors that enhance the wearer’s senses. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.esotuta_cbn.summary: Grants the armor the same functions as a CBN, HEV or WET exosuit respectively (see “Survival”, further on). (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.furtiva.summary: The armor is fitted with special sheaths to prevent it from making noise and its surface is coated with a film of nanoparticles that gives it the ability to change color and camouflage pattern on its own according to the surrounding environment. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.muscolare.summary: Incorporates into the armor a system of synthetic muscle fibers that increase the wearer’s physical capabilities. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.rinforzata.summary: The armor is reinforced to provide more effective protection. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.sistema_di_vestizione_: This system lets you put on and take off the armor with astonishing speed, taking a single action. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.sistema_medico.summary: Incorporates into the armor a medical device that monitors the wearer’s health. (CRB p. 106)
data.enhancements.stabilizzata.summary: The armor is equipped with stabilizers and grants the wearer advantage on checks and saving throws made to avoid being knocked prone or moved against their will. (CRB p. 106)
data.talents.addestrato_nelle_armature.s: You are trained to use armor and shields, making the best of the protection they offer. (CRB p. 46)
data.talents.addestrato_nelle_armature.a: You gain the following benefits: • You ignore the Fortitude requirement of shields and treat all shields as light weapons for the purposes of dual wielding. (CRB p. 46)
You gain the following benefits: • You treat the Fortitude requirement of armor as 1 lower. (CRB p. 46)
You gain the following benefits: • While wearing medium or heavy armor you have advantage on any ability check made to avoid ending up prone or being moved against your will. (CRB p. 46)
You gain the following benefits: • While wearing medium or heavy armor, you gain advantage on all Fortitude saving throws. (CRB p. 46)
data.talents.affinita_cibernetica.summar: When you select this talent your tolerance limit for installing cyberware increases by 3 points (for more information see “Cyberware”, in Chapter 3). (CRB p. 46)
data.talents.ammaliatore.summary: Charmers are psionics who specialize in using their mental gifts to influence other people’s minds and bend them to their will. (CRB p. 47)
data.talents.ammaliatore.abilities.influ: You possess remarkable charming abilities. (CRB p. 47)

When a creature you can see within 10 meters of you makes an attack against you, you can use your reaction and spend 1 psi point to attempt to redirect that attack toward another creature. (CRB p. 47)
data.talents.ammaliatore.abilities.contr: You learn how to turn your enemies’ mental influence powers against themselves. (CRB p. 47)
data.talents.ammaliatore.abilities.asser: By using your action, you are able to enslave the mind of an incapacitated humanoid you are in contact with. (CRB p. 47)
data.talents.artista_marziale.summary: Martial artists dedicate their lives to the practice of martial arts, learning to harness their inner energy. (CRB p. 47)
Thanks to your practice of martial arts, you know how to use your own body as a weapon. (CRB p. 47)
You learn to launch quick attacks when opponents lower their guard. (CRB p. 47)
Whenever you hit a creature with a natural weapon, you can spend ki points to produce one of the following effects. (CRB p. 47)
By spending 1 ki point, you can use your action to make an attack with a natural weapon against any number of creatures adjacent to you, making one attack roll for each target. (CRB p. 47)
data.talents.astronauta.summary: You are used to life in space. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.atleta.summary: You are a skilled athlete who knows how to make the best of your physical gifts. (EC p. 14)
data.talents.atleta.abilities.acrobata.s: You have honed your acrobatic skills, learning to move nimbly in any condition. (EC p. 14)
data.talents.atleta.abilities.ginnasta.s: You have spent a lot of time training in athletic activities such as running and jumping. (EC p. 14)
You have spent a lot of time training in close-quarters wrestling. (EC p. 14)
You have spent a lot of time training in swimming and are perfectly at ease in water. (EC p. 14)
You have spent a lot of time training in climbing, whether rock walls, trees or other things. (EC p. 14)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.summary: You learn to attack your targets stealthily, striking them at their most vulnerable points. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.abilities.a: Once per turn, when you attack a creature and have advantage on the attack roll, if you hit you can deal +1d6 extra damage of the type dealt by the weapon you are using to the target. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.abilities.c: You are deadly when you catch enemies off guard. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.abilities.a: When you land a sneak attack, the extra damage you deal becomes +2d6. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.abilities.s: You learn how to exploit enemies’ distractions to attack them stealthily: your opportunity attacks can always be considered sneak attacks, unless you suffer disadvantage on the attack roll. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.attacco_furtivo.abilities.a: When you land a sneak attack, the extra damage you deal becomes +3d6. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.avanguardia.summary: Vanguards are characters trained in skirmishes and short-range clashes, as expert at setting ambushes as at avoiding them. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.avanguardia.abilities.reazi: You react to danger with great speed. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.avanguardia.abilities.movim: You are skilled at moving among enemies, making yourself harder to hit. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.avanguardia.abilities.evasi: You manage to avoid the worst consequences of the attacks you suffer. (CRB p. 48)
data.talents.avanguardia.abilities.maest: You reach the peak of mastery of skirmish tactics. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.bastione.summary: Bulwarks are bastions of defense, soldiers trained to protect at all costs and to draw enemy attacks onto themselves. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.bastione.abilities.protetto: You know how to protect those near you from enemy attacks, shielding them with your body if necessary. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.bastione.abilities.maestria: You are an expert at defending yourself effectively, making the best of the protection of the armor you wear. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.bastione.abilities.attirare: As a minor action, you can induce opponents to focus their attacks on you. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.bastione.abilities.distrarr: As a minor action, you can attempt to draw the enemies’ attention in order to distract them and benefit your allies. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.summary: Berserkers are warriors who fight pervaded by a brutal, uncontrollable fury that grants them unmatched strength and endurance. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.abilities.ira.sum: In battle you fight animated by primal ferocity. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.abilities.istinto: Your instincts are so sharp that you have advantage on initiative rolls. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.abilities.ira_fur: When you enter a rage you can decide that it is furious. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.abilities.ira_mig: While you are in a rage, you gain the following additional benefits: • At the start of each of your turns you can choose to attack brutally without caring about defending yourself. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.berserker.abilities.ira_sup: While you are in a rage you become relentless. (CRB p. 49)
data.talents.biotico.summary: So-called biotics are psionics who learn to use their psychopower to gain extraordinary resilience, physical enhancement and healing abilities. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.biotico.abilities.mente_sul: You learn to make the best of your psionic power to sustain your body. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.biotico.abilities.fortezza_: You learn to use your psionic power to increase your defenses. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.biotico.abilities.rinvigori: The psychic energy of your powers invigorates your body as you use it. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.biotico.abilities.resistenz: You learn to infuse your body with psychic energy to increase its endurance. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.summary: Hunters are the masters of life in the wild, able to hide skillfully and use the environment to their advantage. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.abilities.esplor: You are an expert explorer of the wilds. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.abilities.preda_: During your turn, as a minor action you can designate a creature you can see as your chosen prey. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.abilities.passo_: You are an expert traveler, with a swift pace and extraordinary endurance. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.abilities.ombra_: You know how to blend in and move in the shadows, going unnoticed by your enemies. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.cacciatore.abilities.nemesi: Once during each of your turns, you can add your WIL score to the attack roll and damage roll of a single attack made against your chosen prey. (CRB p. 50)
data.talents.comandante.summary: Commanders are those who manage the action and use their command abilities to guide and inspire their allies in battle or to strike fear into their enemies. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.comandante.abilities.leader: You inspire authority in your allies. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.comandante.abilities.incita: You can spur your allies to fight with more fervor and courage. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.comandante.abilities.intima: As an action, you can order an opponent that has less than half its maximum vitality points to surrender. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.comandante.abilities.leader: You can use your Rally Allies and Demand Surrender abilities as minor actions, instead of actions. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.combattente_psichico.summar: Psychic fighters specialize in the use of psychopower in battle, learning to infuse their weapons with psionic energy and to manifest their powers while wielding them. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.combattente_psichico.abilit: You are accustomed to using your psychopower in battle. (CRB p. 51)
You learn how to create a psionic bond between yourself and a weapon. (CRB p. 51)
When a hostile creature’s movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to manifest a psionic power on the creature, instead of making the attack. (CRB p. 51)
When you manifest a power that deals damage, you can spend 1 extra psi point to make it automatically deal the maximum possible damage. (CRB p. 51)
You are a master at combining the use of weapons and your psionic powers. (CRB p. 51)
data.talents.demolitore.summary: Demolitionists are individuals specialized in the use of heavy weapons, artillery and explosives. (CRB p. 52)
data.talents.demolitore.abilities.artist: You are an expert in explosives. (CRB p. 52)
data.talents.demolitore.abilities.espert: You are an expert in heavy weaponry. (CRB p. 52)
data.talents.demolitore.abilities.artifi: Explosive devices are your bread and butter and hold no more secrets for you. (EC p. 14)
data.talents.drone_compagno.summary: You know how to build a special companion drone that assists you during fights and exploration. (CRB p. 52)
data.talents.drone_compagno.abilities.dr: You can build a companion drone that serves as support. (CRB p. 52)
You reprogram the drone, increasing its operational capabilities. (CRB p. 52)
When you build a new drone, or by spending 1 hour modifying your current drone, you can apply up to three of the following enhancements of your choice to it. (CRB p. 52)
The drone can be turned into a fixed turret by succeeding on a TEC (Mechatronics) check DC 16 and spending 1 minute of work. (CRB p. 52)
data.talents.entropista.summary: Entropists are psionics who abandon themselves to the tumultuous forces of chaos and entropy that churn beneath the order of the tangible universe. (CRB p. 53)
data.talents.entropista.abilities.psicop: The chaos flowing through your mind has unlocked its potential. (CRB p. 53)
data.talents.entropista.abilities.piegar: You manage to bend fate using the power of your chaotic mind. (CRB p. 53)
data.talents.entropista.abilities.mente_: You learn to partly control the swirling chaotic energies you use. (CRB p. 53)
data.talents.entropista.abilities.intens: The destructive energy of your powers intensifies. (CRB p. 53)
data.talents.entropista.abilities.labiri: You can imprison a creature in a dimensional labyrinth of pure chaos. (EC p. 14)
data.talents.farmacista.summary: Pharmacists are the supreme experts in synthesizing substances designed to interact with the physiology of creatures. (EC p. 15)
data.talents.farmacista.abilities.rimedi: Thanks to your in-depth studies of pharmacology and nutraceutics, you gain the following benefits. (EC p. 15)
data.talents.farmacista.abilities.sintes: Thanks to your pharmacological expertise, every time you finish a full rest you can synthesize an experimental drug. (EC p. 15)

When you use your Experimental Synthesis ability during a full rest, instead of preparing one of your experimental drugs, you can create a dose of one of the substances described in Chapter 1 of this manual and in Chapters 3 and 9 of the Core Rulebook (in the “Substances and Drugs” and “Poisons and Narcotics” sections). (EC p. 15)
You have perfected your experimental synthesis techniques, making them even more efficient and effective. (EC p. 15)
data.talents.furfante.summary: Rogues are adventurers, daredevil scoundrels who chase their fortune, always living on the razor’s edge. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.fortunat: You have a prodigious knack for succeeding in the moment of need. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.impostor: You are a highly skilled impostor. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.temerari: You throw yourself into battle driven by your unshakable bravado. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.guastafe: You learn how to use your cunning to distract someone from what they are doing. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.instilla: If you speak with a humanoid creature that can understand you for at least 10 minutes, you can attempt to instill paranoia in its mind. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.provocat: You can use your action to taunt a hostile creature within 10 meters of you, making a WIL (Cunning) check against the creature’s INT (Composure) check. (CRB p. 54)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.rubacuor: You are skilled at exploiting your charm. (EC p. 15)
data.talents.furfante.abilities.ribaltar: As a reaction, you can let an allied creature you can see roll with advantage on an ability check for which it would otherwise have disadvantage. (EC p. 15)
data.talents.gladiatore.summary: Gladiators are fighters specialized in the use of melee weapons. (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.gladiatore.abilities.assalt: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a minor action to make a melee weapon attack or an attempt to shove against a creature. (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.gladiatore.abilities.stile_: While wielding a two-handed melee weapon, or one with the versatile property held in two hands, you gain the following benefits: • You can choose to take a penalty of up to −5 to the attack roll. (CRB p. 55)
When you fight wielding two weapons you gain the following benefits: • You gain a +1 bonus to Defense. (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.gladiatore.abilities.spezza: You learn the most effective techniques for facing numerous enemies at once. (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.gladiatore.abilities.ammazz: You have learned techniques useful for fighting psionics in melee. (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.gladiatore.abilities.stile_: When you wield a one-handed melee weapon that doesn’t have the bulky property, you gain the following benefits: • Once per turn, when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack that hits, you can reroll the weapon’s damage dice and use the result you prefer of the two. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.hacker.summary: Hackers are the undisputed masters of computer intrusion (the hacking rules are described in Chapter 3). (CRB p. 55)
data.talents.illusionista.summary: Illusionists are psionics specialized in using their mental power to deceive others’ senses and perceptions. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.illusionista.abilities.illu: You skillfully manipulate your illusions. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.illusionista.abilities.svan: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to become invisible. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.illusionista.abilities.dupl: As an action you can create an illusory duplicate of yourself, making it appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 meters of you. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.illusionista.abilities.illu: You manage to manipulate the fabric of reality to make your illusions tangible. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.illusionista.abilities.dupl: When you use Illusory Duplicity, you can create four duplicates of yourself, instead of just one. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.investigatore.summary: Investigators are devoted to solving crimes and mysteries. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.investigatore.abilities.fiu: Thanks to your investigative experience, you gain the following benefits: • You can take the Search action as a minor action. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.investigatore.abilities.ded: If you spend 1 minute observing or interacting with a creature outside of combat, you can glean certain information about its abilities compared to yours. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.investigatore.abilities.cas: You have accumulated an extensive collection of knowledge tied to your past cases. (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.investigatore.abilities.ind: You can deduce crucial information about an object you hold or about the place you are in (a room, an alley or the like, up to a cube 10 meters on a side). (CRB p. 56)
data.talents.mentalista.summary: Mentalists are psionics who develop to the fullest their ability to perceive others’ thoughts and emotions, as well as to shield their own minds from similar actions. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mentalista.abilities.empati: Your telepathic communication gifts are out of the ordinary. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mentalista.abilities.percep: As an action, target a creature you can see within 10 meters of you. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mentalista.abilities.psicol: You can activate this ability by taking an action. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mentalista.abilities.torpor: Your telepathic influence can daze a creature. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mentalista.abilities.barrie: You can activate this ability with an action. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.metapsionica.summary: Metapsionics is the art of controlling and modifying one’s own psionic powers. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.metapsionica.abilities.pote: When you manifest a power that forces creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the full impact of the power. (CRB p. 57)
