When you manifest a power with a range, you can spend one or more extra psi points to increase that range by an equivalent distance for each psi point spent (in other words, the range becomes double by spending 1 psi point, triple by spending 2, quadruple by spending 3 and so on). (CRB p. 57)
When you manifest a power with a duration of 1 minute or more, you can spend 1 extra psi point to double its duration, up to a maximum of 24 hours. (CRB p. 57)
When you manifest a power that targets only one creature and doesn’t have a personal range, you can spend 2 extra psi points to target a second creature within range with the same power. (CRB p. 57)

When you manifest a power that forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 2 psi points to give one target of the power disadvantage on its first saving throw made against it. (CRB p. 57)
When you roll damage for a power, you can spend 1 extra psi point to reroll a maximum number of dice equal to your INT score (minimum one die). (CRB p. 57)
When you manifest a power with a manifestation time of 1 action, you can spend 3 extra psi points to manifest it as a minor action instead. (CRB p. 57)
data.talents.mobilita_senza_peso.summary: You move with ease in the absence of gravity. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.nato_in_sella.summary: You are an expert horseman. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.nervi_d_acciaio.summary: You know how to keep calm and cool even in the most desperate situations. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.pilota.summary: No one can maneuver vehicles and starships better than pilots, true aces at the controls of any craft. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.pilota.abilities.asso_dei_c: Your skill as a pilot is out of the ordinary. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.pilota.abilities.sensibilit: Your sensitivity and attunement to the craft you pilot is extraordinary. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.pilota.abilities.tenere_ins: When the craft you are piloting is reduced to 0 structure points, it is not destroyed immediately but you somehow manage to keep it operational for a number of rounds equal to 1d4 + WIL. During the extra rounds, you and anyone else aboard suffer disadvantage on all ability checks. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.pilota.abilities.legame_del: You grow so fond of the scrap heaps you pilot that you develop an almost mystical bond with them. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.precog.summary: Precogs scrutinize the meanders of time and the infinite future possibilities, managing to insert themselves into the flow of events to change it. (CRB p. 58)
data.talents.precog.abilities.esito_prev: Fleeting images of the future make their way into your consciousness. (CRB p. 58)
When you are targeted by an attack or by an effect that requires a saving throw, you can choose to activate this ability to have a fleeting vision of the imminent danger. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.precog.abilities.sesto_sens: Your precognitive gifts let you look beyond appearances. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.precog.abilities.esito_prev: Your visions of the future intensify and paint in your mind a more accurate portrait of what will happen. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.precog.abilities.futuri_par: You can project your mind a few moments into the future, choosing the course of action that seems most advantageous. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.propensione_psionica.summar: You develop new psionic abilities. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.propensione_psionica.abilit: This ability can be selected multiple times. (CRB p. 59)
You are extremely precise at hitting at range with your psionic powers. (CRB p. 59)
If you are not a psi, you gain a daily pool of psi points equal to 4 + INT and learn a psionic power belonging to a discipline of your choice. (CRB p. 59)
You are particularly resistant to psionic effects. (CRB p. 59)
You have learned how to split your mental concentration while keeping your psionic powers active. (EC p. 16)
You focus on mastering the powers of a psionic discipline. (EC p. 16)
You can manifest your powers with out-of-the-ordinary speed and readiness. (EC p. 16)
When you select this talent you gain resistance to radiation. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.resistenza_fisica.summary: The character is able to better resist pain and bear the weight of wounds. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.resistenza_fisica.abilities: You manage your energies and recover vitality during a combat. (CRB p. 59)
Your maximum vitality points increase by 1 for each even level you have. (CRB p. 59)
You are very hard to kill. (CRB p. 59)
Even when you are on the brink of death, you don’t give up so easily. (CRB p. 59)
data.talents.sapiente.summary: Sages are scholars driven by a love of knowledge, able to dispense useful advice on practically any subject and in any circumstance. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.sapiente.abilities.consigli: Thanks to your vast knowledge, you can dispense practical advice to your allies in order to help them. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.sapiente.abilities.conoscen: The knowledge you have accumulated gives you fragments of information about a bit of everything. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.sapiente.abilities.consigli: Your gifts as an advisor improve further. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.sapiente.abilities.racconti: You can spend a minute talking with an ally, telling them some important anecdote from the past. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.sapiente.abilities.colpo_di: When you or an allied creature you can see within 10 meters of you makes an ability check, you can use your reaction to add to the roll a bonus equal to your INT score. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.spadaccino_psionico.summary: Psionic swordsmen focus their psychic gifts on materializing and wielding deadly blades of telekinetic energy. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.spadaccino_psionico.abiliti: As a minor action, you can create a translucent blade of telekinetic energy extending from one of your hands. (CRB p. 60)
As an action, you create three small, razor-sharp blades of telekinetic energy that you hurl at one or more visible targets within 15 meters of you. (CRB p. 60)
Your mastery of the telekinetic blade increases. (CRB p. 60)
As an action, you create a floating blade made of telekinetic energy that appears at a visible point of your choice within 15 meters of you. (CRB p. 60)
data.talents.stratega.summary: Strategists are keen observers and highly skilled coordinators, experts at analyzing the scenario before them and devising the most effective tactical solutions to prevail in battle. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.stratega.abilities.focus_st: Your strategic acumen lets you coordinate your allies so as to control the battlefield more effectively. (EC p. 16)
data.talents.stratega.abilities.scansion: During your turn you can use a minor action to carefully scan the area designated as your strategic focus, detecting the position of any potential target within it. (EC p. 17)
data.talents.stratega.abilities.ripulire: During your turn you can use a minor action to focus your companions’ efforts on clearing the area of your strategic focus of enemies. (EC p. 17)
data.talents.stratega.abilities.azione_c: During your turn you can use your action to select up to 4 allies who are within the area designated as your strategic focus and who are able to hear you. (EC p. 17)
data.talents.tattiche_di_copertura.summa: You have learned tactics that let you use cover more effectively in combat, both defensively and offensively. (EC p. 17)
data.talents.tattiche_di_copertura.abili: You know how to use cover to make yourself a hard target for enemies to attack. (EC p. 17)
You know how to use cover to your advantage to attack more effectively and at the right moment. (EC p. 17)
data.talents.tecnico.summary: Technicians are the best in the technological field and are able to build, modify and sabotage any kind of device. (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnico.abilities.ferri_del: During a rest, you can make modifications to an omnitool to customize it and adapt it to your needs (the omnitool is described in Chapter 3). (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnico.abilities.modifiche: You further modify your customized omnitool, equipping it with a couple of offensive functions. (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnico.abilities.improvvis: Thanks to your technical expertise, you manage to find ingenious solutions in any kind of situation. (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnico.abilities.specialis: You are an expert at spotting traps and similar hidden devices. (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnico.abilities.sabotator: Using a customized omnitool you can use an action to perform one of the following operations: • You can sabotage a kinetic or energy weapon you are in contact with by succeeding on a TEC (Mechatronics) check DC 16. (CRB p. 61)
data.talents.tecnomedico.summary: Technomedics combine their medical skills with sophisticated scientific and technological knowledge. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tecnomedico.abilities.medic: You know the most cutting-edge medical techniques and therapies. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tecnomedico.abilities.tecno: You know how to provide medical assistance using a series of special healing techniques. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tecnomedico.abilities.anato: You are an expert in the anatomy and physiology of a wide range of creatures. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tecnomedico.abilities.tecno: Your Technomedicine ability becomes more effective. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tecnomedico.abilities.riani: As an action, you can attempt to revive a creature that died moments ago by using one use of a first aid kit and making an INT (Medicine) check DC 18. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tiratore_scelto.summary: Marksmen are able to hit their targets precisely from enormous distances and in any situation. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tiratore_scelto.abilities.o: Your marksman training makes you deadly with ranged weapons. (CRB p. 62)
data.talents.tiratore_scelto.abilities.t: The accuracy of your ranged attacks is out of the ordinary. (CRB p. 62)
You are able to handle ranged weapons with astonishing speed. (CRB p. 62)
You are an expert in the use of ranged weapons in close combat. (CRB p. 62)
Your skill with ranged weapons reaches unrivaled heights. (CRB p. 62)
data.background_traits.accesso_alle_cono: Although others must endure long procedures and pay considerable sums to consult even the most common archives, you have free and easy access to most of the places where knowledge is kept, although these may always contain restricted sections devoted to knowledge too precious (or secret) to be left freely accessible. (CRB p. 32)
data.background_traits.professione_medic: In almost every culture, healers enjoy respect. (CRB p. 32)
data.background_traits.ricercatore.summa: When you try to learn or remember something, if you don’t know that information, you often know where or from whom to obtain it. (CRB p. 32)
data.background_traits.privilegiato.summ: Thanks to your high social standing, people are inclined to treat you with respect. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.seguito.summary: You have three servants in your service, loyal to your family or your title, and one of them serves you as a personal assistant or secretary. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.vita_sfrenata.sum: People are so used to knowing you are involved in scandals of every kind that they no longer pay attention, so you are completely immune to slander or extortion attempts that leverage your dissolute lifestyle or your behavior. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.arte_della_politi: Your experience in politics has taught you how to deal and negotiate in any circumstance, even the most critical ones. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.corpo_diplomatico: While you are in territories that recognize your status as a diplomat, you can more easily obtain an audience with officials, rulers and nobles. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.macchina_dello_st: Your experience in the bureaucratic field lets you interact more smoothly with any government body or agency you deal with, more easily obtaining what you need, even if it means circumventing or bending some rule. (CRB p. 33)
data.background_traits.contatti_criminal: You have a set of reliable contacts in the criminal world. (CRB p. 34)
data.background_traits.famigerato.summar: No matter where you go, people fear you and your reputation. (CRB p. 34)
data.background_traits.impostore_nato.su: When needed you are able to pass for anyone. (CRB p. 34)
When you need to, you can find passage by ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. (CRB p. 34)
data.background_traits.topo_di_bordo.sum: You are an expert on the internal structure of starships and can always find your way around inside them, intuiting and remembering the layout of decks, corridors, hatches and specific areas such as the galley, armory, engine room and so on. (CRB p. 34)
data.background_traits.viandante_dello_s: You are familiar with cosmography and the main travel routes, you know the most important star systems and have probably heard of the lesser-known ones too. (CRB p. 34)
data.background_traits.astro_tecnico.sum: You have worked in large space shipyards, where starships, stations and other structures meant to operate in space are designed and built. (CRB p. 35)
data.background_traits.affinita_tecnolog: You have an innate feel for technology. (CRB p. 35)
data.background_traits.genio_militare.su: Your experience in military engineering has taught you to quickly identify the general features and weak points of fortifications, defenses and other structures of military interest (such as communication towers, power plants, bunkers, hangars, bridges and so on). (CRB p. 35)
data.background_traits.a_grande_richiest: You can always find a place to perform, usually clubs or theaters, but sometimes also circuses, casinos or even a noble’s court or some VIP’s parties. (CRB p. 36)
data.background_traits.piacevole_compagn: You offer your company to anyone who can afford to pay for it. (CRB p. 36)
data.background_traits.contrabbandiere.s: Sometimes people look for “hard-to-get” things and you are the person able to get them for them, at the right price of course. (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.corporativo.summa: As a respected member of a merchant guild, you can enjoy the benefits that such affiliation grants. (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.istinto_del_merca: Whenever you see some interesting object, you are always able to make a rough estimate of its value and remember some interesting information about it (provided there is anything to know). (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.fanatico_ravvedut: You were affiliated with a sect of fanatical cultists, but you left it. (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.riparo_del_fedele: As a religious person, you earn the respect of those who share your faith or who in any case recognize your position as a man of faith. (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.rivelazione_misti: A life devoted to prayer and research has led you to one great discovery. (CRB p. 37)
data.background_traits.operaio.summary: You have learned to operate the most diverse industrial machinery, to know techniques and procedures for loading and unloading goods of every kind from holds, depots and warehouses, as well as to organize work and meet deadlines. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.sapienza_della_te: You are a farmer and the land has taught you a lot. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.tipo_qualunque.su: For better or worse, you seem like a very ordinary sort. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.segreti_della_cit: You have seen so many cities that a few glances are now enough for you to learn to find your way around any urban fabric. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.solidarieta_della: Those who live in poverty are often wary of others, but tend to trust and show solidarity with those who live or have lived in the same condition. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.temprato_dall_ine: Living in hardship has taught you to bear hunger and thirst without batting an eye. (CRB p. 38)
data.background_traits.grado_militare.su: You hold a military rank owing to your service in the army. (CRB p. 39)
data.background_traits.reduce.summary: Those who meet your gaze can sense that you have faced the horror of war. (CRB p. 39)
data.background_traits.vita_mercenaria.s: Thanks to your experience as a mercenary, you are able to recognize mercenary companies by their emblem and know various details about them, including the names and reputations of their commanders and leaders, as well as who has hired them recently. (CRB p. 39)
data.background_traits.anonimo.summary: The years spent as a spy have taught you not to draw attention. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.falsa_identita.su: You have built yourself a second identity complete with documents, knowledge and tricks that let you take on a different appearance. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.rete_di_spie.summ: You have eyes and ears everywhere thanks to a network of reliable agents and informants you have built up over the years. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.cacciatore_di_tag: When you are in a civilized area, you can find information about fugitives and their bounties and obtain the legal authority to hunt, capture or kill such fugitives. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.occhio_del_custod: Your experience as a law enforcer lets you grasp at once what the local situation is in terms of legality, administration of justice and level of criminal activity. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.segugio_urbano.su: Your experience as an investigator lets you find and stay in touch with individuals who may prove useful in your investigations. (CRB p. 40)
data.background_traits.girovago.summary: You have an exceptional memory when it comes to maps, geography and orientation. (CRB p. 41)
data.background_traits.straniero.summary: Your accent, your manners and sometimes your appearance identify you as a stranger. (CRB p. 41)
data.species.chimera.traits.aspetto_dist: Your appearance is so strange and “unnatural” that it causes unease in those who interact with you. (EC p. 8)
data.species.chimera.traits.corredo_gene: Your genome incorporates some peculiar traits. (EC p. 8)
data.species.chimera.reminders.ability_i: Two ability scores of your choice increase by 1. (EC p. 8)
data.species.chimera.reminders.skills.su: You gain two skills of your choice among Acrobatics, Alertness, Athletics, Strength, Reflexes, Survival and Endurance. (EC p. 8)
data.species.chimera.reminders.languages: Espar and one other language of your choice. (EC p. 8)
data.species.contaminato.traits.metaboli: You have advantage on saving throws against poisons and diseases, as well as against any harmful effect caused by ingested, inhaled or injected substances. (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.traits.colpi_po: The entity that contaminates your body grants it extraordinary offensive effectiveness, making you a living weapon. (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.traits.manifest: As a minor action, you can let the taint manifest. (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.traits.furia_co: If you start your turn with less than half your maximum vitality points, you must make a WIL (Resolve) saving throw with DC 12 + half your level (rounded down). (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.reminders.abili: Your Dexterity and Fortitude scores both increase by 1. (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.reminders.skill: You gain two skills of your choice among Alertness, Athletics, Strength, Reflexes and Endurance. (EC p. 9)
data.species.contaminato.reminders.langu: You know the languages normally known by the species you belonged to before becoming tainted (see the Origins trait earlier). (EC p. 9)
data.species.dalok.traits.termovisione.s: In dim light you can see as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.traits.occhi_sensibil: You have disadvantage on saving throws made against effects that make you dazzled or blinded. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.traits.fisiologia_eso: Dalok have a physiology that makes their organism particularly tough. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.traits.affinita_al_fr: You have advantage on rolls made to resist the effects of exposure to cold climates and extremely cold temperatures. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.traits.tradizione_mer: You have advantage on any ability check concerning assessing the value of goods and objects. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.reminders.ability_inc: Your Fortitude and Willpower scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 13)
data.species.dalok.reminders.skills.summ: You gain two skills of your choice among Trade, Insight, Cunning and Endurance. (CRB p. 13)
In dim light you can see as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.traits.biolume.summa: Your body can emit dim light in a 4-meter radius. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.traits.mollusco.summ: Your soft, skeleton-less body lets you occupy the space of a creature up to two sizes smaller than you without squeezing. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.traits.respirazione_: Being a marine creature, you breathe water. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.traits.tentacoli.sum: Your limbs consist of eight tentacles that let you move, act and manipulate objects as effectively as a humanoid. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.traits.esoscheletro_: To survive and operate comfortably outside the aquatic environment, you use a special exoskeleton that supports your body and lets you move in an upright posture. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.reminders.ability_in: Your Dexterity and Intelligence scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.dokran.reminders.skills.sum: You gain two skills of your choice among Insight, Composure, Mechatronics and Sleight of Hand. (CRB p. 320)
data.species.draalani.traits.metamorfosi: Given your hermaphroditic nature you can change sex. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.draalani.traits.sistema_imm: You have advantage on saving throws made to resist poisons and diseases. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.draalani.traits.sapienza_na: You have advantage on any ability check concerning botany, phyto-pharmacology and the properties of plants. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.draalani.reminders.ability_: Your Dexterity and Willpower scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.draalani.reminders.skills.s: You gain two skills of your choice among Charisma, Dance, Insight and Nature. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.draalani.reminders.language: Draalan, Espar and one other of your choice. (CRB p. 15)
data.species.elithrian.traits.senso_tell: You can detect the position of other creatures within 6 meters of you as long as they are in contact with the same surface your feet rest on. (CRB p. 322)
data.species.elithrian.traits.vista_ciec: You have blindsight within a 2-meter radius. (CRB p. 322)
data.species.elithrian.traits.visione_a_: You have advantage on PER checks made to notice potential threats and avoid being surprised. (CRB p. 322)
Thanks to your six legs, you have advantage on checks and saving throws you make to avoid being knocked prone. (CRB p. 322)
data.species.elithrian.traits.emulazione: You can reproduce sounds you have heard, including voices, and can emit up to six different sounds at the same time. (CRB p. 322)
data.species.elithrian.reminders.ability: Your Dexterity and Perception scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 322)
You gain two skills of your choice among Alertness, Charisma, High Society and Reflexes. (CRB p. 322)
data.species.faraxi.traits.braccia_lungh: Your melee attacks have a natural reach of 2 m. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.faraxi.traits.resiliente.su: You have advantage on saving throws made to resist effects that make you sickened. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.faraxi.traits.istinto_di_ri: When you are damaged by a creature you can see within 10 meters of you, you can use your reaction to make a weapon attack against it. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.faraxi.traits.dottrina_di_r: You have advantage on any ability check concerning spirituality, cyclicality, recycling and reuse. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.faraxi.reminders.ability_in: Your Fortitude and Perception scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.faraxi.reminders.skills.sum: You gain two skills of your choice among Alertness, Insight, Mechatronics and Nature. (CRB p. 17)
data.species.infestato.traits.mente_dupl: You have resistance to psychic damage and advantage on checks and saving throws you make to resist effects that read thoughts or that make you charmed or frightened. (EC p. 10)
data.species.infestato.traits.presenza_i: The alien presence that infests your mind emanates a psychic interference that unconsciously induces unease and anxiety in those around you. (EC p. 10)
data.species.infestato.traits.angosciare: As an action, you can focus the psychic interference you emanate to disturb the psyche of a creature you can see within 6 meters of you. (EC p. 10)
data.species.infestato.reminders.ability: Your Intelligence and Willpower scores both increase by 1. (EC p. 10)
You gain the Psychopower skill plus one other skill of your choice among Alertness, Intimidation, Insight, Composure and Cunning. (EC p. 10)
data.species.infestato.reminders.languag: You know the languages normally known by the species you belonged to before becoming infested (see the Origins trait earlier). (EC p. 10)
data.species.iradian.traits.apnea.summar: Iradian are not amphibious but are evolutionarily akin to aquatic life. (CRB p. 19)
data.species.iradian.traits.mente_lucida: You have advantage on saving throws made to resist effects that make you charmed. (CRB p. 19)
data.species.iradian.traits.vocazione_ps: You know one praxis of your choice. (CRB p. 19)
data.species.iradian.traits.sapienza_sto: You have advantage on any ability check concerning archaeology and ancient history. (CRB p. 19)
data.species.iradian.reminders.ability_i: Your Intelligence and Willpower scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 19)
data.species.iradian.reminders.skills.su: You gain two skills of your choice among Lore, Composure, Music and Psychopower. (CRB p. 19)
In dim light you can see as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. (CRB p. 21)
data.species.jaraki.traits.prontezza_pro: You have advantage on initiative rolls, unless you are surprised. (CRB p. 21)
data.species.jaraki.traits.sapienza_gene: You have advantage on any ability check concerning biotechnology and genetic engineering. (CRB p. 21)
data.species.jaraki.reminders.ability_in: Your Perception and Technique scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 21)
data.species.jaraki.reminders.skills.sum: You gain two skills of your choice among Trade, Deception, Cunning and Reflexes. (CRB p. 21)
data.species.kandrevan.traits.rigenerazi: You are able to heal the permanent consequences of any physical trauma over 2d4 days (including regrowing missing body parts). (CRB p. 23)
The symbiosis with the plague modifies every Kandrevan at the genetic level, granting them peculiar mutant characteristics. (CRB p. 23)
data.species.kandrevan.traits.mente_sugg: You have disadvantage on saving throws made to resist effects that make you charmed. (CRB p. 23)
data.species.kandrevan.traits.dottrina_d: You have advantage on any ability check concerning urban legends and pop culture. (CRB p. 23)
data.species.kandrevan.reminders.ability: Your Fortitude score increases by 1. (CRB p. 23)
You gain two skills of your choice among Visual Arts, Survival, Endurance and Streetwise. (CRB p. 23)
You are immune to being dazzled. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.traits.struttura_pos: Thanks to your mighty physical build, you are considered one size category larger for determining your carrying capacity and in any situation in which a larger size could have a positive effect. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.traits.resilienza_ke: You have advantage on rolls made against effects that cause exhaustion and you have resistance to radiation. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.traits.dottrina_dell: You have advantage on any ability check concerning disputes of honor and the traditions related to them. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.traits.insofferenza_: As a native of a hot planet you suffer disadvantage on rolls made to resist the effects of exposure to cold climates and extremely cold temperatures. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.reminders.ability_in: Your Combat and Fortitude scores both increase by 1. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.kergan.reminders.skills.sum: You gain two skills of your choice among Resolve, Strength, Intimidation and Endurance. (CRB p. 24)
data.species.khel.traits.infravisione.su: In dim light you can see as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. (CRB p. 324)
data.species.khel.traits.apnea.summary: You can hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to 10 + FRT. (CRB p. 324)
data.species.khel.traits.morso.summary: You can make melee attacks using your bite. (CRB p. 324)
data.species.khel.traits.spazzata_di_cod: You can use your tail to make attempts to shove melee opponents. (CRB p. 324)
